## Functions that change state

| Function | Who can call | Also |
|---|---|---|
| `grantRole(bytes32 role, address account)` | The role's admin role (`DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` unless set otherwise) |  |
| `register(address fc, uint8 kinds)` | `onlyRole(REGISTRAR_ROLE)` |  |
| `remove(address fc)` | `onlyRole(REMOVER_ROLE)` |  |
| `renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account)` | Only the account renouncing its own role |  |
| `revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account)` | The role's admin role (`DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` unless set otherwise) |  |

## Read functions

Anyone can call these; they change nothing.

| Function | Returns |
|---|---|
| `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE()` | bytes32 |
| `getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role)` | bytes32 |
| `hasRole(bytes32 role, address account)` | bool |
| `isActive(address fc)` | bool |
| `KIND_COOP_AGENT()` | uint8 |
| `KIND_CUSTODY()` | uint8 |
| `kindOf(address fc)` | uint8 kinds, bool active |
| `REGISTRAR_ROLE()` | bytes32 |
| `REMOVER_ROLE()` | bytes32 |
| `supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId)` | bool |
